name: AutoReproduce Benchmark (ourbench)
description: Efficient reproduction of research papers is pivotal to accelerating scientific progress. However, the increasing complexity of proposed methods often renders reproduction a labor-intensive endeavor, necessitating profound domain expertise. To address this, we introduce the paper lineage, which systematically mines implicit knowledge from the cited literature. This algorithm serves as the backbone of our proposed \ours, a multi-agent framework designed to autonomously reproduce experimental code in a complete, end-to-end manner.
